SELECT o.OrderNo, o.Qty
FROM   dbo.OrderHeader o WITH (NOLOCK)
JOIN   dbo.OrderLine  l WITH (NOLOCK) ON l.OrderNo = o.OrderNo
WHERE  o.Status = 3;
